acceptance: ci-required-result requires the impacted canary shards for non-empty selections and fails on selector failure or missing or inconsistent output, with workflow tests for each case.
The PR includes the pre-written revert and states the rollback trigger.
A 7-day report after landing gives blocked merges (with causes), merge-queue p50 time to merge against the prior 7 days, and any canary failures the gate missed.
The D3 decision on pull_request gating is recorded, even if the answer is merge_group only.
context:
Guardrails:
1. Maintainer approval of this PR is required (pr.yml and ci-required-result are soundness paths); no auto-merge.
2. The PR must include a pre-written revert: removing the jobs from the umbrella and restoring continue-on-error.
3. Rollback trigger, fixed now and not tuned later: revert the same day if, in any rolling 7 days after landing, (a) the required job blocks 3 or more merges whose failures are later shown to be flakes or infrastructure, or (b) merge-queue p50 time to merge rises by more than 15 minutes against the 7 days before landing. Revert first, then investigate; do not add exceptions to keep the gate.
4. A canary failure the gate did not catch after landing is a selector bug: open an item for it the same day and link it here.
5. Workflow tests cover: non-empty selection required and failing blocks; zero selection passes; selector failure blocks; missing output blocks; whole-suite fallback required.
6. The daily release canary stays as the full backstop; do not reduce it.
